title: 84쪽 · 3x LJ — SB 3-Bet (7%)
sourcePageBasis: capture sequence, checked against surrounding folios
paragraphs: There are only two situations where | don't 3-bet my entire continuance range out of the small blind. This first one is in multi-way pots. There are times when you can't profitably squeeze out of the small blind... but you can profitably flat because you have a hand that performs well out of Position in multiway pots (e.g. small pocket pairs).

The second situation is when there's a huge fish in the big blind. At that point, the small amount of EV that you would gain by 3-betting a hand like {A-10s is dwarfed by the EV you would gain by flatting and allowing the big blind to peel with a huge range of hands that he will play poorly Post-flop.
